bias.zh: 反弹 · 收复 10 日均线，仍低于 $171–177

read.en: Marvell rose 9.3% on Nov 11 to $168.80, trading $162.50–174.53. It is above the 5-day ($150.5) and 10-day ($167.1) and below the 30-day ($225.2), 100-day ($227.9) and 200-day ($186.2); only the 200-day is rising. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($191.8), and RSI is 38.3.
read.zh: Marvell 11月11日上涨 9.3%，收于 $168.80，盘中区间 $162.50–174.53。股价位于 5 日（$150.5）和 10 日均线（$167.1）上方，30 日（$225.2）、100 日（$227.9）和 200 日均线（$186.2）下方；仅 200 日均线在上行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$191.8），RSI 为 38.3。

read.en: The rally cleared the $154.8–158.6 zone and the $162.9 Jul 29 low, now support; the $174.53 high stalled in the $171.4–177.3 band (Nov 2–3 closes, Nov 3 high). Resistance is $171.4–177.3, then $186.2 (200-day) and $191.8 (SAR). Support is $162.5–167.1 (10-day, Jul 29 low, Nov 11 low), then $154.8–158.6 and $147.5–150.5. A close above $177.3 would target $186; below $162.5, $155–158.6.

s.en: Nov 4 low $154.78; Nov 9–10 highs ($157.68–158.59); May 12 low $157.96, cleared
